result.one_liner: Pylon is a support helpdesk platform offering REST API access for customer support automation and integration.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication, which means you'll need to pass your API token in the header of your request.
MCP Server uses OAuth 2.0 (AuthKit) for authentication
API access is included on the professional and enterprise tiers
Only Admin users can create API tokens
Public REST API available at https://api.usepylon.com
Official Pylon MCP Server exposes 23+ tools for AI integration

result.notes: API requires Professional or Enterprise paid plan subscription (minimum 3-7 seats). 14-day free trial available but API access only on paid tiers. Self-serve token generation for workspace admins on paid plans. Official MCP server provides convenient AI tool integration.
